title: Managing spatio-temporal heterogeneity of susceptibles by embedding it into an homogeneous model: A mechanistic and deep learning study.
summary: Fitted to Shanghai COVID-19 data, the model estimated time-varying susceptible recruitment and an effective susceptible fraction near 3.4%; estimates are model-dependent rather than direct population measurements. The finding is bounded to the reported study and does not establish causal benefit or generalization.
